Dear Commanders,

We have addressed a ridiculous bug that slipped through testing, causing the ships to attack in a strange order and sometimes making the enemy ships too powerful.

Whether you have positive, negative, or constructive feedback, don't hesitate to contact us at wecureboredom@proton.me.

notes.title: Update - V 1.4.1
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders,

We’re thrilled to introduce this major update!

New Platform
  
 The game is now available on the Steam Deck! We're also working with Steam to earn the compatibility badge.


Under the Hood
  
 Future-proofed the game by upgrading Unity from 2021 to 2023.
 Enhanced overall performance, particularly on skirmish maps with many ships.


UI/UX Improvements

 Introduced a General View: zoom out to see color-coded planets and ships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44477180/f6e887cca479b165a0a406ec40e02aa4110e30d2.png
 Improved enemy ship coloring, including red thrusters for easier enemy identification.
 Added voice-overs for in-game dialogue.


We welcome all feedback, whether positive, negative, or constructive. Contact us at wecureboredom@proton.me.

Happy gaming,
The We Cure Boredom Team

notes.title: Update V102
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders,

We appreciate your valuable feedback, and we've taken the following actions to enhance your gaming experience:


Resolved the issue with WASD and screen edge camera movement not functioning
Rectified the problem with the Select Menu icon not disappearing
Addressed the HUD ship counter not updating
Fixed game-breaking bugs occurring in higher levels
Lowered the volume on various combat audio clips
Enhanced the visual effects of lasers


Wishing you a Happy New Year from the Cure Boredom team! 
May your gaming adventures be out of this world, in a galaxy free from extraterrestrial interference!
